name: Flappy Shoot
author: Addicting Games
description: Flappy Shoot is a FlappyBird-style sports game that’s fun to play on mobile devices. Instead of flying in between pipes, you must guide your winged basketball through various basketball hoops. Avoid bumping into the hoops or the ceiling or else you lose the game. The hoops are stationed at different heights that you must drop your ball into to increase your score. Also, pay attention to the coins found along your path. Collect the coins to unlock all 12 of the cool character skins for your player. This is a fun instant game that’s easy to play because of its simple instructions. There’s no need for a tutorial with this sports game. Just hit the play button, and get straight to the game using just your finger or mouse. Click on the leaderboard to see how you rank against other Flappy Shoot players.
